title: Livelihood College Campus
tagline: Grand institutional campus featuring monumental colonnade entry and dynamic wing planning
description: A comprehensive institutional facility designed for vocational education and skill development in Raipur. Features symmetrical architectural wings angled around a central civic plaza, solar shading louvers, high-volume atrium, and full CAD elevation engineering.

details.Key Elements: Symmetrical Splayed Wings, Monumental Canopy, CAD Elevation Drawings, Academic Auditoriums
